# x402Slugify

> Deterministic URL-safe slug generator for agents. Lowercase, hyphenated, ASCII-normalized. No accounts. Pay per call with x402 (USDC on Base).

## Paid Endpoint

- POST /api/slug
  - Input: `{ "text": "...", "maxLength"?: number, "separator"?: "-" }`
  - Output: `{ "success": true, "slug": "...", "meta": {...} }`
  - Price: ~0.005 USDC

## Free Discovery

- GET /catalog
- GET / (service card)

## Why agents use it

- Zero variance, pure string transform
- Perfect for generating canonical IDs, file names, route segments, and SEO-friendly keys
- Token-cheap and high-frequency safe
